name: plants mine by created
sql: SELECT p.id FROM plants p WHERE p.user_id = ? ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 50

name: plants mine by name
sql: SELECT p.id FROM plants p WHERE p.user_id = ? ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE, p.id LIMIT 50

name: plants public by created
sql: SELECT p.id FROM plants p WHERE p.is_public = 1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 50

name: plants public by name
sql: SELECT p.id FROM plants p WHERE p.is_public = 1 ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE, p.id LIMIT 50

name: substrates mine by created
sql: SELECT s.id FROM substrates s WHERE s.user_id = ? ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 50

name: substrates mine by name
sql: SELECT s.id FROM substrates s WHERE s.user_id = ? ORDER BY s.name COLLATE NOCASE, s.id LIMIT 50

name: substrates public by created
sql: SELECT s.id FROM substrates s WHERE s.is_public = 1 ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 50

name: substrates public by name
sql: SELECT s.id FROM substrates s WHERE s.is_public = 1 ORDER BY s.name COLLATE NOCASE, s.id LIMIT 50

name: components by name
sql: SELECT c.id FROM components c ORDER BY c.name COLLATE NOCASE, c.id LIMIT 50

name: substrate_components by component_id
sql: SELECT sc.substrate_id FROM substrate_components sc WHERE sc.component_id = ?

name: plants by substrate_id
sql: SELECT p.id FROM plants p WHERE p.substrate_id = ?

name: newest plant image
sql: SELECT i.image_url FROM images i WHERE i.entity_type = 'plant' AND i.entity_id = ? ORDER BY i.upload_date DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT 1
